tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Fabrication, Erection, Rectification and Commissioning of lifting beam of 20T Tailrace gantry crane at Supa Power House
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer O and M Office KVP Supa

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder should have work experience in Supply/Fabrication/Erection/Rectification/Repair and Commissioning of lifting beams of different capacity of gantry cranes in preceding last five years. (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work/ purchase order of value not less than Rs. 1.21 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any reputed Industry/PSU/Government organization and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level )

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Fabrication, Erection, Rectification and Commissioning of lifting beam of 20T Tailrace gantry crane at Supa Power House

itemList.description: Fabrication & Replacement of both lifting beam "J" hooks of the 20T Gantry crane:Supply of material for fabrication of "J" shape hooks along with Bronze bush inserted within MS Bush for the draft tube gate's gantry crane lifting, including cost of materials, fabrication, machining, erection, transportation, tools and tackles, leads and lifts etc. as per site requirement. The "J" hook size 1200x 500 MM thickness: 32 MM material: MS 2062.

Replacement of guide shoes of 20T Gantry crane:Supply of material for fabrication of side guide shoes along with ms rollers, bronze bush and HSS fastners for the draft tube gate's gantry crane lifting beam complete, including cost of materials, fabrication, machining, erection, transportation, tools and tackles, leads and lifts etc. as per site requirement.

Fabrication & Replacement of both locking and unlocking mechanism of the lifting beam:Supply,Repair and Rectification works of locking and unlocking arrangemnt of the lifting beam including cost of materials, fabrication, machining, erection, transportation, tools and tackles, leads and lifts etc. complete. as per site requirement.
Testing and Commissioning: Testing, Commissioning and trial run operation of the crane by lowering and lifting of the draft tube gates as per direction of engineer in charge.
